data.one_liner: Animate.css port for Flutter with 97 effects and original keyframes.
data.what_it_does: Provides 97 CSS animation effects ported directly from Animate.css for Flutter widgets. Includes support for custom keyframe tracks, curves, and respects accessibility reduced-motion settings by default.
use_when: You want to replicate exact Animate.css web effects in a Flutter application
You need pre-built attention seekers, fades, zooms, and sliding transitions without manual tween setup
You want support for reduced-motion accessibility settings out of the box
avoid_when: You need timeline-based heavy physics animations or Rive/Lottie vector graphics
You are using a Flutter version older than 3.47
strengths: All 97 effects and original keyframes from Animate.css
Supports custom keyframe tracks and CSS cubic-bezier curves
Built-in accessibility support for reduced motion
weaknesses: Not modeled: visibility on slide* and backface-visibility on flippers
Requires a relatively recent Flutter SDK (3.47 / Dart 3.13)
